execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
library(rnaturalearth)

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

mallards_sf <- mallards |>
  filter(lat >= 46, lat <= 55,
         long >= 7, long <= 25) |>
  arrange(timestamp) |>
  group_by(duck_id) |>
  mutate(order = row_number()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "#dfe7eb", color = "#8a8a8a", size = 0.3) +
  geom_path(
    data = mallards_sf,
    aes(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
        y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2],
        group = duck_id,
        color = duck_id),
    alpha = 0.75,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = mallards_sf,
    aes(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
        y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2],
        color = duck_id),
    size = 1.2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma", begin = 0.2, end = 0.9) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard duck GPS fixes, 2007–2017",
    subtitle = "Each color is one individual duck; lines show movement paths",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = "Duck"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#dfe7eb", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 32, face = "plain", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 22, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 16)),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 10, 20)
  ) +
  labs(caption = "Source: Korner, Sauter, Fiedler & Jenni (2016) via Movebank (CC BY)") +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 20)))
```
